stages.title: Manual Spreadsheets and Reactive Billing

GST set-aside calculated manually at month end
Follow-ups sent ad hoc with generic templates

keyInsights: Verve Commerce averages 9 days past due date on analytics milestones
Input tax credit from software tools offsets 12% of quarterly GST
Firm follow-up tone resolves overdue retainers 2.1x faster than polite nudges

stages.title: Grounded Provenance, UPI QR Settlement, and CFO Forecasting

keyInsights: Zero ungrounded invoice dates or missing tax line items
Instant UPI QR scan reduces client settlement friction
Clear cash-flow buffer recommendations across active retainers
